question: Which bank has been the worst for credit card customers this year?

outputs.final_text: The report is ready! It covers the top companies across three dimensions — complaint volume, relief rate, and timely response rate — with Capital One drawing the most complaints overall (9,558) and Barclays Bank Delaware standing out for its very low relief rate (6.6%) among major issuers.

report.title: Worst-Performing Banks for Credit Card Customers, 2026
findings: Capital One received the most credit card complaints of any company in 2026 (Jan–Aug), with 9,558 complaints, followed by Citibank (8,326) and Synchrony Financial (6,358).

Barclays Bank Delaware stood out as the weakest performer among major issuers on relief: only 6.6% of its closed credit card complaints resulted in any relief for consumers (Jan–Jun 2026), the lowest of the top 10 companies by volume.
JPMorgan Chase also had a low relief rate at 19.6%, and Capital One was close behind at 21.6% — both well below the 42.5% relief rate seen at Citibank and the 47.3% at Bread Financial.
Synchrony Financial was the only top-10 company with a timely response rate below 100%, at 93.4% of complaints receiving a timely response (Jan–Jun 2026).
Combining high complaint volume and low relief, Capital One presents the broadest concern: 9,558 complaints received and only 21.6% of closed complaints resulted in relief for consumers.
